instruments.title: Goabddá. Divination drum with skin tympanum painted with figures and symbols.
Goabddá. Divination drum with designs on the skin membrane and openwork carving on the base.

Birch wood drum decorated reindeer skin membrane with beater, pointer and stand made by Helge Sunna. Used with the T-shaped reindeer antler beater and antler pointer and purpose made museum stand and antler suspension peg

household.title: Spectacle case made by Irina Nutti. Made from reindeer leather (sisti) and decorated with woollen cloth and pewter thread. The case is rounded at both ends, one end open (for insertion of spectacles) this end can be closed with vecro strips (sewn on the inside). One side and the bottom have a seams, along which has been sewn green woollen cloth. A diamond shape has been cut from the front of the case, in this has been sewn blue woollen cloth, this has been outlined with a thin strip of green woollen cloth. In the centre of the blue cloth has been sewn pewter thread in a much embellished cross shape (which has arms of equal length).

Small purse made by Susanna Nordqvist. Made from sisti (de-haired reindeer leather). The bottom is rounded, made from a piece of leather which has been gathered sewn to an oval shaped piece both back and front. The body of the purse (when closed) is covered by a flap which folds over the main body of the purse. On this flap has been sewn a piece of green woollen cloth, this is decorated with red cloth and pewter thread sewn in a central abstract design. There is also some red woollen cloth under the pewter thread.

textile.title: Watch strap, made by Irina Nutti, composed of de-haired reindeer leather (sisti), yellow woollen textile, and pewter thread. Base is a rectangular band of leather with rounded corners. Edges of the leather are turned over a smaller band of yellow woollen textile, sewn with waxed nylon thread, and decorated with geometric designs in pewter thread. Back has two slits, through which a narrower leather strip is passed; one end has five small perforations, other end has a metal buckle, possibly of nickel.
